description:
The Huffy Extent 26-Inch Mountain Bike is designed for riders ready to go farther and explore more. Whether it's neighborhood streets, park paths, or light trails, this mountain bike delivers the confidence and capability needed for everyday adventures. Rugged styling and dependable performance make every ride an opportunity to discover something new.
Front and rear disc brakes provide strong, reliable stopping power when the terrain changes, while the 21-speed shifting system helps riders smoothly tackle hills, straightaways, and varying conditions. A front suspension fork absorbs bumps along the way, creating a more comfortable and controlled ride wherever the journey leads.
A durable hardtail frame and wide all-terrain tires are built to handle everything from sidewalks to dirt paths with steady traction and confidence. The comfortable saddle supports longer rides, and an included kickstand makes parking easy when it's time to take a break. Built for teens and older riders, the Huffy Extent is ready for every ride, every challenge, and every new adventure.
